name: growth-300k-p1
description: G4, growth proper (theory-2 6.24): fresh-gate probit trees (NB router, split noise 0.03), limit 8, split threshold 300k x2 against 1M x2; the threshold the one factor. At 1M the gate's window holds trees at 3 leaves or fewer (probit-limit8-p1). Prediction: 7-15 leaves held at 300k, 10-30 more Elo. Launched 11-11 08:47 by the coordinator for the user's six-model shortlist (theory-2 6.24). F-P x2 added to the field (a deviation from 6.24's four-line design) so the gain over the same leaf's flat is measured in the same field, as in probit-widen-p1b/p1c. Own games at T 0.1 (T 0.02 training costs 100-200); read cold at T 0.02 at plies 1-2.
